tools.name: search_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Search the KEVWire corpus (CISA KEV, NVD high/critical CVEs, GitHub advisories, national CERTs, security reporting, editorial records). Default order is "urgent": the last 30 days first, then known exploitation, CVSS 9+, breaches. Every result includes source URLs to cite.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Fetch a record by CVE ID, GHSA ID, or KEVWire record ID, including every source, measurement date, CISA deadline, and a permalink.

tools.name: recent_exploited
tools.description: Vulnerabilities with documented exploitation (CISA KEV or explicit reporting) published within the last N days, most urgent first.

tools.name: list_technologies
tools.description: Technology labels usable as filters, with how many records each covers. Optionally filter by text.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Every source KEVWire ingests, with scope, limitations, retrieval status, last success, and record counts. Use this to describe coverage honestly.
